environment.description: Same application deployed identically on EC2 behind ALB, but the ALB is associated with an AWS WAFv2 Web ACL. The Web ACL contains a single rule group reference: a custom rule group 'corp-input-validation-rg' with capacity 500. This rule group contains two rules: (1) 'block-uri-path-traversal' which inspects UriPath with a regex pattern matching '../' sequences (priority 1, action BLOCK), and (2) 'normalize-query-encoding' which applies URL-decode + HTML-entity-decode text transformations to AllQueryArguments and then matches against a regex pattern `(?i)(?:union[\s/\*]+select|select[\s/\*]+(?:(?:all|distinct)\s+)?[\w*]|(?:insert|update|delete)\s+(?:into|from)|(?:drop|alter|create)\s+(?:table|database|index)|(?:;|--|#|\/\*))` (priority 2, action BLOCK). The Web ACL default action is ALLOW. CloudWatch metrics enabled for the rule group with sampled requests retention.
